item.title: CryptoQuant CEO calls rising Bitcoin hashrate ‘indirect bullish signal’ from institutions
item.description: Public miners backed by major TradFi players are coming back online, boosting Bitcoin’s hashrate, a positive sign for BTC’s fundamentals, according to CryptoQuant’s Ki Young Ju.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Thailand SEC says several companies eye crypto ETFs, none has applied
item.description: Thailand’s SEC says several asset managers have sought consultations on spot crypto ETFs, but it cannot confirm whether the first funds will launch in 2026.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: SoFi unveils bank-issued tokenized deposit for yield-bearing crypto funds
item.description: SoFi Bank launched SoFi Earn, a tokenized deposit paying 4.40% APY with FDIC coverage, allowing users to convert funds to stablecoins 24/7.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Robert Lakin

item.title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
item.description: DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: The UK needs a workable route to regulated DeFi access
item.description: The UK’s 2027 crypto rules risk a de facto ban on regulated firms providing access to DeFi, argues Coinbase’s European policy head Katie Harries.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Katie Harries

item.title: CoinDCX admits ‘operational losses’ after $16M wallet transfers draw scrutiny
item.description: CoinDCX said it covered losses caused by a failed transfer process involving compromised wallets and credited all affected user accounts.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin corrects below $82K after Tesla Q3 results, KOSPI falls
item.description: Bitcoin reversed a run toward $85,000 after Tesla reported lower-than-expected capital expenditure in Q3.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Starknet voters back research into life beyond Ethereum
item.description: StarkWare plans to release a draft whitepaper in November as it explores an independent, quantum-resistant blockchain.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: PHP flaw draws millions of exploit attempts, Cloudflare CEO warns
item.description: Cloudflare’s Matthew Prince said the network saw thousands of exploit attempts even before the PHP vulnerability was publicly disclosed.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs bag another $528M, taking 3-day haul past $1B
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $1.08 billion over three trading sessions to push October flows back above water.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Move over memecoins: Crypto ‘meme games’ coming, bagholders and all
item.description: “Plenty will be ponzis. Plenty will get exploited. Plenty will insta die. There will be ridiculous gains, and people will get absolutely f***ing rinsed,” says Illuvium co-founder Kieran Warwick.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: PHP Foundation admits ‘structural failure’ delayed critical security fix
item.description: Government websites and online services were disrupted after concerns about a PHP bug that could allow attackers to take control of vulnerable servers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: American Bankers Association: OCC’s GENIUS rules ‘undermine’ US Congress
item.description: Banking advocacy organizations are pushing back against the OCC’s finalized rules on a stablecoin law, arguing against changes to provisions on yield.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Tether backs Bolivian fintech bringing USDT payments to food delivery and banking
item.description: The investment will support Peso’s expansion across four Latin American markets, where it connects stablecoin payments to merchant services and local banking networks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Trump didn‘t mention ‘crypto’ once in White House cybercrime roundtable
item.description: The US President detailed many schemes defrauding Americans, but referred only to “cybercurrency“ related to scams.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Cardano Foundation urges EU against expanding MiCA rules to DeFi and staking
item.description: The foundation called for regulation based on financial risks rather than technology, warning that overlapping rules could create uncertainty for crypto businesses across the EU.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: UK financial watchdog opens consultations for DeFi guidance, crypto laws
item.description: The UK Financial Conduct Authority consultations came just weeks after the agency opened applications for companies under its new crypto regulatory regime.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent likens GENIUS Act to Lincoln-era banking reform
item.description: The OCC has finalized rules for stablecoin reserves and redemptions, with Bessent calling the GENIUS Act a “watershed moment for American finance.”
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Chainlink, Cardano, other blockchain groups push SEC for clearer crypto rules
item.description: Six major blockchain organizations urged the SEC to formally recognize digital commodities as non-securities in its proposed regulatory framework.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin price tags $84.6K as US stocks head higher on SpaceX Q3 earnings beat
item.description: Bitcoin extended gains to approach $85,000 after US stock markets reacted to higher-than-expected SpaceX earnings.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality
item.description: Solana’s first major consensus upgrade is targeting 99% finality reduction, seeking to offer users near-immediate transaction settlement and more responsive applications.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Big Tech’s eMudhra fixes may leave crypto bots exposed, CertiK warns
item.description: CertiK says crypto trading bots and exchange applications may remain exposed to the eMudhra certificate flaw because browser fixes may not protect all software.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: 5 alternatives to Ledger to store your Bitcoin
item.description: Hardware wallets aren’t the only way to protect your crypto, but from ETFs and passkeys to multisig accounts, each alternative has its own risks and trade-offs.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers and custody
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency’s final rule covers payment stablecoin issuance and some custody activities, with the GENIUS Act framework taking effect in mid-January.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Robert Lakin

item.title: Standard Chartered signs definitive deal to acquire Zodia Custody
item.description: The signing follows shareholders’ acceptance of Standard Chartered’s non-binding offer in May, with regulatory approvals still pending.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: PancakeSwap TVL tops $380M as major fee overhaul heads to vote
item.description: PancakeSwap’s proposed fee-sharing overhaul would give liquidity providers 88% of swap fees and cut CAKE emissions by 69%, as BNB Chain’s DeFi activity expands.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: France proposes liability for crypto exchanges offering DeFi access
item.description: French authorities want crypto exchanges to conduct checks on DeFi protocols and face liability for certain customer losses under proposed changes to EU crypto rules.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Bitcoin ‘top buyers’ halt BTC price upside with $87.7K now key: Glassnode
item.description: Bitcoin price current resistance near $87,000 was reinforced by investors who bought BTC in late 2025, per new research.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Shinhan, SBI make Japan-Korea tourist spending a test case for yen stablecoins
item.description: The companies will assess safeguards for travelers and whether stablecoins can speed up trade settlement between South Korea and Japan.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun
